subject: LedgerPay: evidence roadmap and timeline for SOC2, retention, and pen-test artifacts
messages:
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>
To: Elena Varga <elena.varga@ledgerpay.com>, LedgerPay Security <security@ledgerpay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Oct 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: LedgerPay: evidence roadmap and timeline for SOC2, retention, and pen-test artifacts

Hi Elena / LedgerPay security team —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our side and proposed evidence path so we can move to a procurement-ready review: 

Top pain points you called out:
- Need for sample audit logs (7–30 day slices) that show token-level events and privilege escalations.
- Clear retention SLOs for logs and embeddings (particularly for payments data).
- SOC 2 artifact mapping and timeline for providing control evidence.
- Desire to run or witness a pen test report and agree remediation SLAs before a production go-live.

Goals we heard:
1) Security sign-off for a pilot (up to 10k requests/day) within 4–6 weeks.
2) A DPA that reflects encrypted-at-rest keys + 90 day log retention, with options for extended retention on request.
3) A clear acceptance checklist for procurement so contracts can move quickly.

Proposed immediate next steps (from Redwood):
- Attach: RDW_Security_Summary_2026-10.pdf (summary of controls + what we can share publicly).
- Share a redlined DPA template (attached: DPA-redline-v2.docx).
- Provide a 7-day audit-log sample exported as CSV (we can redact PII).
- Align on pen test expectations: we can share our most recent pen test report under NDA and schedule an evidence walkthrough with our security engineer.

Can you confirm which of the above are must-haves for the pilot sign-off vs desirable items for full-prod? Also, who on your side should we include on the DPA redline thread (legal/procurement)?

I'll follow up with a concrete timeline once you confirm.

Thanks,
Nikhil Sharma
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
n.sharma@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

--
Attachments: RDW_Security_Summary_2026-10.pdf (summary, 8 pages)

From: Elena Varga <elena.varga@ledgerpay.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>
Cc: LedgerPay Security <security@ledgerpay.com>, procurement@ledgerpay.com
Date: Thu, 08 Oct 2026 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: LedgerPay: evidence roadmap and timeline for SOC2, retention, and pen-test artifacts

Hi Nikhil —

Thanks for the clear summary. A few clarifications from our side: 

Must-haves for pilot sign-off:
- 7-day audit log sample showing authentication events, API token usage, and admin actions.
- A DPA that explicitly states data residency (US) and encryption key management responsibilities.
- Evidence that embedding storage can be purged on request and that we can control retention parameters at the tenant level.

Nice-to-haves for pilot but required before production:
- Full SOC 2 Type II report or at least the SOC 2 bridge letter plus mapped control descriptions.
- Recent pen test report; if that cannot be shared, a plan to either run a joint pen test or allow LedgerPay to run an external assessment.

Who to include: procurement@ledgerpay.com for contracting, and I'll loop in our Head of Infosec (cc'd) separately once we have a DPA draft.

Two quick asks: can you provide the audit log sample as CSV (no PII) and include a small readme describing fields and retention semantics? Also send a redline-friendly DPA in docx.

Thanks — will aim to review attachments by EOD Friday.

Best,
Elena
Head of Security Programs | LedgerPay
Elena.Varga@ledgerpay.com

--
On Wed, Oct 7, 2026 at 4:12 PM Nikhil Sharma <nsharma@redwood.com> wrote:
> [original message]

From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>
To: Elena Varga <elena.varga@ledgerpay.com>, LedgerPay Security <security@ledgerpay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, procurement@ledgerpay.com
Date: Fri, 09 Oct 2026 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: LedgerPay: evidence roadmap and timeline for SOC2, retention, and pen-test artifacts

Elena — thanks for the priorities. Per your asks we've attached the following and included notes inline: 

Attachments included:
- audit-log-sample-7days.csv (redacted, columns: timestamp,event_type,user_id,token_id,resource,ip_address,country,notes)
- DPA-redline-v2.docx (editable, highlights where we typically see customer requests)
- RDW_Security_Summary_2026-10.pdf (controls map)

Notes on retention and embeddings: 
- Tenant-level retention controls are supported via the console and API; default retention for logs is 90 days but can be reduced to 7 days for pilot. Embedding deletion is supported with a purge API and a retention SLO of 48–72 hours to fully clear vector stores depending on shard configuration.

Pen test / SOC2: 
- We can provide our latest pen test report under NDA. If LedgerPay requires a separate assessment, we can coordinate windows and provide a stab at remediation SLAs (30 business days for medium-high findings, 60 for critical until mitigation plan is accepted).
- SOC 2: we cannot publish the full Type II without an NDA/procurement approval, but we can produce a controls mapping + bridge letter to get procurement comfortable.

Next steps we propose:
1) Elena / security: confirm NDA path so we can share pen test + SOC2 artifacts (if NDA, Redwood will send an external vendor NDA link).
2) Procurement: confirm whether DPA-redline-v2.docx can be the starting doc and provide any clause requests.
3) Redwood: schedule a 30-minute walkthrough with our security engineer (Marissa) to review the audit-log sample and retention mechanics. Proposed times: Mon 10/12 9–11am PT or Tue 10/13 1–3pm PT.

I'll schedule the walkthrough tentatively for Mon 10/12 10:00am PT and send a calendar invite; please ping if that doesn't work.

Thanks,
Nikhil
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

--
Attachments: audit-log-sample-7days.csv (CSV, redacted), DPA-redline-v2.docx (docx, 12 pages)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Elena Varga <elena.varga@ledgerpay.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, procurement@ledgerpay.com
Date: Fri, 09 Oct 2026 09:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: LedgerPay: evidence roadmap and timeline for SOC2, retention, and pen-test artifacts

Elena / team —

Appreciate the quick feedback. A couple internal notes for transparency and to set expectations on our end: 

- Walkthrough scope: we'll demonstrate how logs are exported, retention controls, and the embedding purge process. We'll include sample API requests you can run in a sandbox.
- Timeline: If LedgerPay signs the NDA and returns a limited DPA redline within 7 business days, we expect to be able to move to a pilot within the 4–6 week window discussed.
- Evidence delivery: pen test report and SOC bridge letter will be delivered via secure share (Link and access instructions) once NDA is in place.

Action items (owners):
- LedgerPay: confirm NDA path and legal contact (Elena).
- Procurement: review DPA-redline-v2.docx and send redlines to procurement@redwood.com.
- Redwood (Marissa): host walkthrough and upload secure artifacts to the drive link.

I'll attach the calendar invite in a separate email; looking forward to the walkthrough.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Principal Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
